title: China Capitalizes on America’s Scientific Brain Drain
gist: More than a dozen established US scientists, including Nobel laureate Omar Yaghi, left for China this summer, driven by frustration with Trump administration immigration and security policies. Short excerpt.

insights.claim: This summer more than a dozen established scientists in fields from quantum computing to biochemistry to AI left US universities for China, including Nobel laureate Omar Yaghi leaving UC Berkeley to lead an AI research institute at Tsinghua University.
insights.speaker: Catherine Tan
insights.so_what: Talent flow strengthens China's position in AI and quantum research.

insights.claim: The departures were fueled by frustration with the Trump administration's stringent immigration and national security policies, and an unprecedented number of researchers say they are considering leaving the US.
insights.speaker: Catherine Tan
insights.so_what: A sustained brain drain would erode US research leadership in strategic technologies.
insights.locator: These departures had been long in the making
